headline: CISA flags exploited Cisco RCE; vCenter bug under attack since September; GL.iNet cloud flaw hits routers; four KEV fixes due today

bullets.text: New, critical: CISA has flagged a critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks, BleepingComputer reports. Separately, Cisco Expressway hard-coded credentials CVE-2026-76466 is in KEV with a federal due date of today, 11-23.

New, critical: Google says last week's critical VMware vCenter bug (CVE-2026-123890, auth bypass) was already under attack in September. KEV due date is today, 11-23, alongside Apache Roller CVE-2026-129448 and SAP NetWeaver CVE-2025-42884.
New, critical: attackers are exploiting a GL.iNet cloud flaw to infect routers and KVM devices, per BleepingComputer. No CVE in the report.

New breaches: Cleverbridge says hackers stole credit card numbers and CVVs; Peninsula Energy warns of disruption after a Wyoming cyber incident; Bromcom's 355,051 accounts were added to Have I Been Pwned.

Still active: a Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data (no CVE yet), the reported FBI criminal justice database hack, and the Rackspace Spot breach exposing customer Kubernetes secrets.

SITCON eased to 3 (ELEVATED) from 2: 4 KEV additions in three working days and 27 critical reports in two; SITCON 2 if the next sweep agrees. Last 7 days scored 1.1x the 90-day average. Leak-site claims led by n0n (120), SoulGroup (27), vortex (26).

actions: Patch VMware vCenter (CVE-2026-123890) today and hunt for compromise back to September.
Patch Cisco Expressway (CVE-2026-76466) and apply Cisco's fix for the newly flagged exploited RCE; restrict management exposure meanwhile.
Patch or isolate Apache Roller (CVE-2026-129448) and SAP NetWeaver (CVE-2025-42884); KEV due date is today.
GL.iNet router and KVM owners: update firmware, disable cloud management you don't use, and check devices for signs of infection.
Entra tenants: follow Microsoft guidance on the Connect Health flaw and review audit logs; Rackspace Spot customers: rotate Kubernetes secrets.
Plan ahead: Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Chromium CVE-2026-125350 are due 11-24; LiteLLM CVE-2026-40217 due 12-02.
